title: A refused holder-only verb still moves the session's focus to the target item
outcome: A refused holder-only verb still moves the session's focus to the target item
acceptance: When a holder-only verb such as note, update or done is refused (for example work_invalid because a live handoff offer blocks it), the session's focus is unchanged, and the error carries no focus_change
Successful verbs keep their existing focus behavior
A test covers a refused note on a non-focused item and asserts that focus stays on the previous item

completion.summary: A refused holder-only verb (note, update, done) no longer moves the session's focus and its error carries no focus_change; successful verbs keep their focus behavior.
